The Great Commission

The gospel calls us
to care and to go.

Have Compassion on Them Missions brings together believers with a shared burden to reach others for Christ. Some go into unreached fields. Some intercede in marathon prayer. Some provide food, shelter, and financial care. Together, we serve our Lord Jesus Christ.
